column1: # test/jobs.tsv - the job manifest (TESTREORG stage 1).  One row per job id that tools/run_changed.sh runs.  Tab separated; the first non-# line is the header.
# Paths are relative to test/ (golden files relative to test/golden/).  The file records what the scripts do and is checked against the tree by tools/jobs_check.sh.

# TESTREORG stage 2: a job is MOVED when the first script of its row has a '/' (today: rd -> ring/ring_detector.*, and since stage 3 the 18 jobs of tone, cid, fsk, callprog, core, since stage 4 the 29 jobs of v22, voice, v8, dsp, since stage 5 the 40 jobs of fax, since stage 8 the 20 jobs of v32 / fpm, and in stage 9 (the last) the 17 jobs of v34, v04 of v34/handshake and the 4 jobs of module cross: EVERY row is moved now); tools/job_path.sh, run_changed.sh, run_job.sh, stampkeys.py and
# test/lib/tier_golden64.sh read the files of moved jobs from this table (the branches of those tools for a job that is not moved are dead since stage 9).
# The later stages move files with git mv (module by module) and update the rows in the same commit.

#   id        the job id as run_changed.sh knows it.  TESTREORG stage 10 (the ids were renamed LAST): id == new_name (the planned name, no '?' marker), e.g. ring/ring_detector; the old ids (rd, p07 ...) resolve through
#             tools/job_aliases.tsv.  Stamps are test/.stamps/<fid>, fid = id with '/' replaced by '__'; test/jobclass.txt and the xfail list test/golden/tier_golden64_xfail.txt are keyed by this id
#   module    the src/ module of the code under test: the src/ directory of the job's primary library file (v34/handshake for the handshake); 'cross' = no single module
#   new_name  planned id and file stem: <module>/<stem of the primary src file>[.<facet>]  (facet = what the job adds to its siblings of the same stem)
#   script    the files that run the job, comma separated: the stage-1 script, wrapper / shared scripts it execs, the stage-2 <id>_golden64.sh if one exists
#             (a job with only a golden in golden/ is stage 2 through test/lib/tier_golden64.sh <id>)
#   harness   the other test/ files of the job: harness mains (.c/.cpp), their quote-included headers, layout files, python checkers; comma separated.  NOT listed because every
#             job shares them: stub_env.c, harness/ (harness.c / harness.h), blob.sh, flags.sh, flagshim/, lib/tier_golden64.sh, jobclass.txt
#   golden    files of test/golden/ the job owns (id-prefixed files and files its scripts name); the shared tier_golden64_xfail.txt is not listed
#   stage2    yes = the job has a x86-64 stage 2 (own <stem>.golden64.sh or lib/tier_golden64.sh with a golden), no = stage 1 only
#   notes     args=... (the argument run_changed.sh passes to the script), g64=own|tier, and uncertain module / name assignments ('?' prefix)
# Derived once from the scripts by a throw-away script (not hand-copied); tools/jobs_check.sh verifies the rows against the tree.  '?' in module or new_name = judgement, see notes.
